subject: [PATCH v3 2/8] nfsd: Honor delegated timestamps when change and size match

2026-11-09.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFSv4 server where delegated timestamps are not honored when the change and size attributes match. The problem occurs because the holder's WRITEs do not update the mtime or change attribute on the server, causing other clients to see new data with the pre-WRITE mtime. The patch addresses this issue by always applying the CB_GETATTR times for timestamp delegations, recording applied times in the delegation structure, and marking the file modified if necessary. Additionally, it fixes issues related to atime updates and reporting of the stat-based change attribute.
